testCase.name: [local] S03 UAT journey as written: Hospital on 2 real consecutive days, Nursing Home visits on different days, timeline read as a trend view

descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S03 UAT journey as written: Hospital on 2 real consecutive days, Nursing Home visits on different days, timeline read as a trend view

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 One entry per completed visit, correctly dated, in chronological order, never duplicated. (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 AC 3)
  • U2 A day the patient was not seen is legitimately absent: no entry and no filler line for it. (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 description 2)
  • U3 Hospital: the timeline shows yesterday and today only, per the retention rules. (UAT TC-11; UAT 3.6; TFA-92589 AC 4)
  • U4 Nursing Home: entries are keyed by visit number and labelled 'Visit N – date'. (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 AC 5)
  • U8 Run in both modes for one patient each: Hospital across 2 consecutive days, Nursing Home across 3+ visits. (UAT TC-11; UAT 3.3)
  • T2 A new timeline entry is created automatically on every completed note, generated from that day's finished note. (TFA-92589 AC 2; TFA-92589 description 1)
  • T4 The timeline is readable as a quick trend view across the stay. (TFA-92589 AC 8; UAT TC-11)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Local stack only, kept running across the 3 days, with live AI (never the store / TestFlight build, never dev): one Hospital patient and one Nursing Home resident on an @roundai.test account

When Hospital: complete a note on day 1 and on day 2, and view the chart again on day 3. Nursing Home: complete visits on three different days with one day skipped, then review the timeline

Then Hospital day 2 shows the day 1 and day 2 entries; on day 3 only day 2 and day 3 (day 1 is off the cards). Nursing Home shows Visit 1–3, each with its own date, the skipped day absent, no duplicates. The tester then reads the timeline instead of the notes and records whether the trend of the stay is clear

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): The tester compares the timeline with the list of completed visits and their dates; every failure quoted. Q3 decides the day 3 edge. T4 (folded in from the former S24): the entries are recorded and a person rates them as a trend view; there is no written oracle (Q8), so that part has no verdict

Where it ran: local manual (time lane, a script does the person's steps); test method TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S03 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-11.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane manual.

Test method: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); secondary: EXPLORATORY · Exploratory testing — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: manual.

UAT item: TC-11 Course Timeline · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-11/S03

UAT journey as written: Hospital on 2 real consecutive days, Nursing Home visits on different days, timeline read as a trend view

Tickets: TFA-92589 Course Timeline (ready for qa)

Re-verdict after the QA review of TFA-92589 (2026-10-14; not yet checked by Quinn): needs a person. All 11 judged cells are on the pre-round row (stored with ⏳); the UAT's core, the entry a finished note writes, never ran (no Generate locally). The pre-round step also called the real model locally, against the 10-14 rule. The rest goes to dev. The run's own result was pass; its evidence is below.

New local lane manual: status passed-partial in manual/results.json → passed (partly passed (every judged cell passed; part was not run / was mocked)).

How it is tested (manual/plan.json, automatable: partly): chromium spec, live AI (5 pre-round Save Notes). Every course entry is written by the app's own pre-round Save Note (usePreRoundProcess / useSnfPreRoundProcess) with the browser clock (page.clock) on that day; the server's time:now answer is withheld at the Convex socket so the device clock stands (src/data/time.ts: 'A failed ask changes nothing'), the server clock is never moved. Hospital: Save Note on day 1 (D-2) and day 2 (D-1), Course Timeline read on day 2 and on day 3 (D0). Nursing Home: Save Notes on D-3, D-1 and D0 (D-2 skipped), Visit Timeline read after visit 3. Judged: one entry per day/visit with its own date, order, no duplicates, the skipped day absent, day 1 off the Hospital cards on day 3 (Q3-independent: 48 h old and two calendar days back). Recorded: T4 trend rating (Q8, a person rates the saved cards; 5-minute checklist), the day-1 line still in the ledger (Q2/T5). Not run: the Generate-completed entries (forbidden locally; dev lane). — The date/count/order/skipped-day cells are deterministic and run on the app's own Save Note path. T4 'is the timeline a readable trend view' has no written oracle (Q8), so a person rates it (record-only). Entries made from a finished note need Generate, which is forbidden on the local stack (dev lane); here the entries are the pre-round lines (Q12).

Detail:

11/11 judged cells pass, 3 recorded, 2 NOT RUN. Not run: entries generated from the finished note (Generate Note & Finish on day 1 and day 2) (Generate is forbidden on the local stack (capabilities.json); the dev lane runs it. Here every entry is the pre-round line (Q12)) | entries generated from the finished visit note (Generate Note & Finish at each visit) (Generate is forbidden on the local stack (capabilities.json); the dev lane runs it. Here every entry is the pre-round line (Q12)). Recorded: day 3: day-1 line still in the stored ledger (cleared vs hidden is Q2 / T5, TFA-94699) = {"day1InLedger":true,"ledger":["Oct 12: CHF exacerbation admitted overnight. Started IV furosemide and supplemental oxygen. Weight 82 kg. As | T4: the Hospital cards as a trend view (Q8: no written oracle; a person rates it) = {"day2Cards":["Oct 12: CHF exacerbation admitted overnight. Started IV furosemide and supplemental oxygen. Weight 82 kg. Assess diuretic res | T4: the Nursing Home Visit Timeline as a trend view (Q8: no written oracle; a person rates it) = {"cards":["Visit 1 – Oct 11: Patient admitted for rehabilitation following left hip ORIF. Ambulating 10 feet with walker, pain controlled at.

During the run (runNote): Intermittent, not counted: in 4 Save Notes today (TC-20/S17 NH during the 14:4x overload; TC-21/S17 Hospital at 16:55; TC-11/S03 NH at 16:59 and 17:02 JST) the text was saved but the structured summary never arrived and no error was set within 90 s (preRoundProcessing stuck true, or no notesProcessedAt and no preRoundError); the retries were clean. No aiCallLog row was captured for those attempts, so the cause (model latency vs app) is open; worth watching on dev. Observation, not judged: every entry the Save Note writes ends in a doubled full stop ('…oxygenation.. ⏳ Encounter pending.', '…Continue PT/OT..'): the writers append '.' to a model entry that already ends in one (usePreRoundProcess / useSnfPreRoundProcess).

Manual checklist (manualChecklist):

  • [TC-11/S03 one step left: rate whether the timeline's trend is clear (T4; Q8 has no written standard, so record only, no Pass/Fail; about 5 minutes, no sign-in needed)]
  • The date / count / skipped-day / no-duplicate cells are already judged automatically (cells-hospital.json, cells-nursing-home.json).
  • 1. Open evidence/TC-11-S03/hospital-day2-pre-round.png and hospital-day3-pre-round.png; look only at the Hospital Course → Course Timeline cards, not the notes.
  • 2. Open evidence/TC-11-S03/nursing-home-after-visit3-pre-round.png; look only at the three Visit Timeline cards.
  • 3. Answer in one sentence for each: is the trend of this stay clear? (yes / no + one reason); write it into this entry's personRating in results.json.
  • Note: locally these cards are the row a pre-round Save Note writes (Generate is off locally; Q12, whether a pre-round row without a finished note counts as an entry, is not decided yet); the cards after a note finished with Generate have to be run on dev.

Evidence: 7 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — The given says local stack only, never dev, and doing it in one sitting needs the aging helper and a server-clock control, both through the local admin key; dev has neither.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
